ask: mkae a fair rotaton for shotgn plz
sentence: Randomly assigns the four front seats across a trip there and back, so each person gets at most one seat and nobody gets a seat in a car they drive.
use_when: A group is carpooling in two cars and needs a fair way to pick who sits in front
People are arguing over shotgun and want a random draw
A trip has an outbound and a return leg and each front seat needs a different person
dont_use_when: The group needs a turn order for a game or for speaking
You need to split people into teams or groups
You need a yes or no vote or a poll on a choice
